code: import axios from'axios';const API_URL='http://localhost:5001/api/cart';const getCart=()=>{return axios.get(API_URL);};const addToCart=(productId,quantity,price)=>{return axios.post("".concat(API_URL,"/add"),{productId,quantity,price});};const updateCartItem=(productId,quantity)=>{return axios.put("".concat(API_URL,"/update"),{productId,quantity});};const cartService={getCart,addToCart,updateCartItem};export default cartService;
